## Import Packages

```{r}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(SingleCellExperiment)
  library(scater)
  library(tidyverse)
  library(zellkonverter)
})
```

## Load Data

Experimental data obtained via snakemake workflow from https://github.com/HelenaLC/type-state. Data is originally from: 
Kang et al. (2018) Multiplexed droplet single-cell RNA-sequencing using natural genetic variation. Nature Biotechnology 36: 89-94

```{r}
sce_raw <- readRDS("../../data/kang/00-raw/Kang18.rds")
sce <- readRDS("../../data/kang/01-pro/Kang18.rds")
cd <- readRDS("../../data/kang/01-pro/Kang18-cd.rds")
rd <- readRDS("../../data/kang/01-pro/Kang18-rd.rds")
```

## Summary and Exploration

```{r}
# dimensions
cat("Genes x Cells: \n", as.character(dim(sce)), "\n \n")

# gene and cell names
cat("Gene Names: \n", head(rownames(sce)), "... \n \n")
cat("Cell Names: \n", head(colnames(sce)), "... \n \n")

# assays
cat("Assays: \n", assayNames(sce), "\n \n")

# metadata
cat("Gene metadata: \n", colnames(rd), "\n \n")
cat("Cell metadata: \n", colnames(cd), "\n \n")
```

```{r}
# cell type proportions
cd %>% 
  select(cluster_id) %>% 
  count(cluster_id) %>% 
  mutate(proportion = n / sum(n)) %>% 
  arrange(desc(proportion))
```

```{r}
# distances in PCA space
pca <- reducedDim(sce, "PCA")
ct <- colData(sce)$cluster_id

dist_by_type <- lapply(unique(ct), function(t) {
  mat <- pca[ct == t, , drop = FALSE]
  d <- dist(mat)
  mean(as.numeric(d))
}) %>%
  setNames(unique(ct))

dist_by_type
```

## Visualization

```{r}
cd$UMAP1 <- reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[ , 1]
cd$UMAP2 <- reducedDim(sce, "UMAP")[ , 2]
cd$TSNE1 <- reducedDim(sce, "TSNE")[ , 1]
cd$TSNE2 <- reducedDim(sce, "TSNE")[ , 2]
```

```{r}
cbf_palette = c(
    "#E69F00",  # Orange
    "#56B4E9",  # Sky Blue
    "#009E73",  # Bluish Green
    "#F0E442",  # Yellow
    "#0072B2",  # Blue
    "#D55E00",  # Vermillion
    "#CC79A7",  # Reddish Purple
    "#999999",  # Gray
    "#117733",  # Dark Green
    "#882255",  # Wine
    "#44AA99",  # Teal
    "#DDCC77",  # Sand
    "#88CCEE",  # Light Blue
    "#AA4499",  # Magenta
    "#332288",  # Navy
    "#E17C05",  # Burnt Orange
    "#DC267F",  # Pink
    "#648FFF",  # Vivid Blue
    "#785EF0",  # Violet
    "#FE6100"   # Bright Orange
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = cd,
  mapping = aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = cluster_id)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cbf_palette[3:10]) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "UMAP1",
       y = "UMAP2",
       colour = "Cell Type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 18,
        face = "bold"
      )
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),
  )

ggsave(
  "dat_types.png",
  last_plot(),
  path = "../../outs/kang/",
  width = 6,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
ggplot(
  data = cd,
  mapping = aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = group_id)
) +
  geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = cbf_palette[1:2]) +
  labs(title = "",
       x = "UMAP1",
       y = "UMAP2",
       colour = "Treatment") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    plot.title = element_text(
        hjust = 0.5,
        size = 18,
        face = "bold"
      )
  ) +
  guides(
    colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),
  )

ggsave(
  "dat_states.png",
  last_plot(),
  path = "../../outs/kang/",
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

```{r}
cd %>% 
  mutate(
    s = paste(group_id, sample_id, sep = "_")
  ) %>% 
  ggplot(
    mapping = aes(x = UMAP1, y = UMAP2, colour = s)
  ) +
    geom_point(size = 1, alpha = 0.7) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = cbf_palette[1:8]) +
    labs(title = "",
         x = "UMAP1",
         y = "UMAP2",
         colour = "Sample") +
    theme_classic() +
    theme(
      text = element_text(size = 16),
      plot.title = element_text(
          hjust = 0.5,
          size = 18,
          face = "bold"
        )
    ) +
    guides(
      colour = guide_legend(override.aes = list(size = 3)),
    )

ggsave(
  "dat_samples.png",
  last_plot(),
  path = "../../outs/kang/",
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  dpi = 300
)
```

## Export Objects for Use in Python

```{r}
# sce object
sce_file <- "../../data/Kang/01-pro/Kang18.h5ad"
writeH5AD(sce, sce_file)

# metadata dfs
write.csv(cd, "../../data/kang/01-pro/Kang18-cd.csv", row.names = TRUE)
write.csv(rd, "../../data/kang/01-pro/Kang18-rd.csv", row.names = TRUE)
```
